review: Runs every game I play at high settings, the RTX 4070 is a beast in this small body.
The 120Hz OLED screen is the best I've seen on a gaming laptop, games look incredible.
For browsing and notes the battery lasts around 7 hours, which is decent for a gaming laptop.
Fans get really loud when gaming, you need headphones.
Speakers are punchy and loud, surprisingly good for a laptop.
The bottom gets very hot during long gaming sessions.
Aluminium build feels premium and it's compact enough to carry to college.
Battery life while gaming is barely an hour and a half.
Screen, performance and design are all excellent. Best laptop I've owned.
Perfect mix of portability and power. Video editing in Premiere is smooth.
Armoury Crate software is bloated and keeps popping up notifications.
Keyboard is comfortable with nice per-key lighting.
Plenty of ports including HDMI and USB-A, no dongles needed.
Fan noise even during light tasks sometimes, silent mode helps a little.
The charger brick is big and heavy, which ruins the portability a bit.
Coil whine is noticeable in quiet rooms when the GPU is under load.
Expensive, but you're paying for a thin gaming laptop with a great screen.
